changelog: A requested movie or season that was removed from Radarr/Sonarr, or is unmonitored there, is no longer shown as Searching forever: its placeholder is removed after 10 minutes (only while all services are reachable). Requests that never reached Radarr/Sonarr are not shown.
description: Keeps a shared "Coming Soon" library of requested movies and shows that haven't arrived yet, with download progress and ETA in the item overview. Placeholder items are not playable.
name: Coming Soon
overview: Download progress library for Seerr, Sonarr and Radarr
